refined_requirements.name: Formation Type Distribution Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Analyze the frequency of different formation types used by each team to identify their preferred strategies.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Change Over Time Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Examine how the formation types change across different time intervals (e.g., match phases or game periods) for both teams.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Matchup Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Compare the formation types used by the two teams against each other to identify patterns in their tactical interactions.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Effectiveness Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Evaluate the correlation between specific formation types and match outcomes (e.g., wins, losses, draws) for each team.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Usage Rate by Game Phase
refined_requirements.description: Analyze how often each formation is used during different phases of the game (e.g., first half, second half, overtime).

d.name: Argentina_Formation.data
d.description: Input data table for Argentina's formation data

d.name: Brazil_Formation.data
d.description: Input data table for Brazil's formation data

D.name: Argentina_Formation_Distribution
D.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type used by Argentina
D.task: Group the 'formation_type' column from d1 and count the occurrences of each type.

D.name: Brazil_Formation_Distribution
D.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type used by Brazil
D.task: Group the 'formation_type' column from d2 and count the occurrences of each type.

D.name: Formation_Change_Over_Time
D.description: Analyze how formation types change across different time intervals for both teams
D.task: Segment the data by time intervals (e.g., first half, second half, overtime) and calculate the frequency of each formation type within each interval for both teams.

D.name: Formation_Matchup_Analysis
D.description: Compare the formation types used by Argentina and Brazil against each other
D.task: Cross-reference the formation types from d1 and d2 to identify common and unique formations used by each team during the same match phases.

D.name: Formation_Effectiveness
D.description: Evaluate the correlation between formation types and match outcomes for each team
D.task: Join formation data with match outcome data (if available) and calculate the win/loss/draw rates for each formation type used by Argentina and Brazil separately.

D.name: Formation_Usage_Rate_By_Phase
D.description: Analyze how often each formation is used during different game phases
D.task: Group the formation data by game phase (first half, second half, overtime) and calculate the usage rate of each formation type for both teams.

V.name: Formation_Matchup_Heatmap
V.description: Compares the formation types used by Argentina and Brazil against each other

V.name: Formation_Effectiveness_Bar
V.description: Shows the effectiveness of each formation type in terms of match outcomes for both teams

V.name: Formation_Usage_Rate_By_Phase_Bar
V.description: Analyzes how often each formation is used during different game phases for both teams
